x: Tom Taylor also made his BAL debut for us and had two splendid second places. Chris Cornwell equalled the Club Record and became our first 2.00 High Jumper in BAL Competition.

In the final BAL Match at Southark Park Hugh Teape (Enfield) won the 110H with a new Division record of 14.0. Close behind was our own Tom Taylor who this season has lowered Club record to a highly respectable 14.5 sec.
